understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to move every selectable piece onto a goal tile marked '+' in each level; all goals had to be occupied simultaneously to win the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces moved in 3-pixel grid increments. Walls or boundaries could block movement, while adjacent pushable blocks could potentially be moved by attempting movement. CLICK was intended to switch between selectable pieces using their pixel coordinates, but repeatedly clicking [12,15] did not change the selected piece in the observed state. Movement hints were not always definitive, and blocked moves consumed steps.
